{"name": "execute_blender_code", "arguments": {"code": "import bpy

# Основание, тело и голова снеговика

base = bpy.context.active_object
bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=1.1, location=(0, 0, 3.6))
body = bpy.context.active_object
bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.75, location=(0, 0, 5.1))
head = bpy.context.active_object
bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()

# Морковка (нос)
import math
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=0.15, depth=0.8, location=(0, -0.9, 5.1))
nose = bpy.context.active_object
nose.rotation_euler = (math.radians(-90), 0, 0)

# Материал снега
snow = bpy.data.materials.new('Snow')
snow.use_nodes = True
bsdf = next(n for n in snow.node_tree.nodes if n.type == 'BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (0.95, 0.95, 1.0, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.5
for obj in [base, body, head]: obj.data.materials.append(snow)

# Материал морковки
carrot = bpy.data.materials.new('Carrot')
carrot.use_nodes = True
c_bsdf = next(n for n in carrot.node_tree.nodes if n.type == 'BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
c_bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (1.0, 0.4, 0.0, 1.0)
nose.data.materials.append(carrot)
"}}
